notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.92
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.92[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] is here.

It's a pretty big update with an upgrade of the [b]Champion[/b] and [b]Storm Warrior[/b] classes, some important [b]bug fixes[/b], a few [b]AI and interface improvements[/b], and a [b]new button[/b] in the Module Editor's monster/NPC Creation Wizard.

[list]
[*] Upgraded the [b]Champion[/b] and [b]Storm Warrior[/b] character classes. Champions now have access to the new feats Battle Benediction, Blessed Hands, Mercy of the Heavens, Wrath of the Heavens, and Sanctified Giant, while Storm Warriors now have access to the new feats Rolling Thunder, Ironbark, Primal Ferocity, Environmental Aptitude, Furious Lightning Storm, and Wind Mastery. Champions now select a specialisation option called "[b]Sacred Emblem[/b]" (choose between Battle, Miracles, Might, Vitality, Mercy, Dominion, and Faith), while Storm Warriors now select a specialisation option called "[b]Tempest Path[/b]" (choose between Stormblade, Warmaster, Lifetotem, Earthbreaker, Stormguard, Wildcaller, Spellweaver, and Cataclysm).
[*] In the module Augury of Chaos, gave a Sacred Emblem to Champions, and a Tempest Path to Storm Warriors. Also, you'll be able to [b]choose a Tempest Path for Driaghan[/b] through the game's dialogue, if he joins the party.
[*] If a dialogue option is not available due to the party's Bard not having an [b]equipped musical instrument[/b], or the party's Rogue not having [b]Rogue tools[/b], or the party not having a required item, or the party not having a required companion, or the party not having enough gold, the mousing-over tooltip will now let you know. For example, the tooltip will display "Impossible: Musical Instrument Not Equipped" when mousing over a "Bard Perform" dialogue option.
[*] In the party creation screen, fixed a bug with the tick box "[b]Hide non-matching characters[/b]" not hiding characters who don't meet the class or race requirements for the selected module.
[*] Improved the [b]combat AI for melee-focused creatures[/b] that have access to a move action (or free action) Spell-Like Ability.
[*] Improved the [b]combat AI for Barbarians[/b], as well as the intelligence settings of the Barbarian named [b]Jorad[/b] in the Augury of Chaos prologue.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]attack path calculation[/b] when mousing over an enemy. It would sometimes result in the "Target Too Far Away" message even though the character could actually move to a square adjacent to the target and attack.
[*] When selecting "[b]overwrite saved game[/b]" in the Save Game screen, the game will now keep the name of the selected saved game.
[*] Added a [b]new button[/b] in the Creation Wizard allowing you to set the [b]Feats distribution type[/b] for the new creature. The options are "one Feat per three levels + 1 at level 1", "one Feat per two levels + 1 at level 1", "one Feat per level" and "two Feats per level". This feature may be used to create [b]elite monsters[/b] and NPCs.
[*] [b]Storm Warriors[/b] and [b]Druids[/b] will no longer be able to cast spells while wearing metal armour (after character creation). But see the new feat called "[b]Ironbark[/b]".
[*] Fixed a couple of issues with the [b]Bard[/b] feat [b]Story Teller[/b]. Temporary Hit Points will now be allowed out of combat, up to 20 points for each character, allowing the feat Story Teller to work as expected. Also added a note about this in the Help Entry about Temporary Hit Points.
[*] Fixed a dialogue text display issue when selecting the [b]Cat Familiar option[/b] during the prologue of Augury of Chaos in Finchbury. Thank you [b]Arkain[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] Fixed a dialogue text display issue / dialogue answer display issue / dialogue skill checking issue when clicking on the corpse at the very beginning of Chapter 1 of Augury of Chaos. Thank you [b]Arkain[/b]!
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when loading a game with, say, seven party members, opening the inventory screen, then loading a game with, say, five party members, and opening the inventory screen (as that screen was still expecting seven party members).
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] after closing the [b]Formation Screen[/b], when a new character joins the party (especially if you changed the party leader).
[*] Fixed an issue where a module would crash when casting a [b]spell dealing physical damage[/b], if the module's weapons file was missing the entries for Warhammer, Longsword or Rapier.
[*] Fixed a display issue in the Feats & Abilities screen of the Character Sheet of [b]undead creatures[/b].
[*] Fixed a tooltip display issue when mousing over the title line of the [b]Party Items box[/b], and over the title line of the [b]Floor Items box[/b].
[*] Fixed an incorrect body-slot setting for the item "[b]Greatclub[/b]".
[*] Added a clarifying note in the help entry for the feat "[b]Black Wizard Improved Scare[/b]".
[*] Fixed a help button in the [b]Psychic Warrior[/b] creation interface which was leading to the Paladin's help entry.
[*] Added a note in the help entry of the [b]Healing[/b] Cleric/Bishop Domain Power and [b]Healing Mastery[/b] feat to indicate that they grant the Healing skill to the character automatically. Also, the Healing skill will be shown in the Character Sheet, if you have this feat or that domain power.
[*] Fixed a bug with the feat [b]Green Wizard Improved Alteration[/b] granting the spell [b]Enhance Weapon[/b] two bonus points instead of one.
[*] Fixed an issue with the display of the skill "[b]Streetwise[/b]" when it comes from the expanded skill set.
[*] Improved the help entry for the feat "[b]Divine Weapon[/b]" of the Champion.
[*] Fixed Creation Wizard issues with the application of the [b]Psychic Warrior[/b] Focus.
[*] Fixed Creation Wizard issues with the extra weapon group proficiencies of [b]Gladiators[/b] and [b]Psychic Warriors[/b] with the Focus of Prowess.
[*] Fixed Creation Wizard issues with the award of bonus feats associated with the Focus of Prowess specialisation of the [b]Psychic Warrior[/b] and the Swashbuckler specialisation of the [b]Rogue[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug in the old-style [b]Character Creation interface[/b] when selecting a class specialisation then clicking on one of the ability scores.
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]Creature Editor[/b] where switching tabs (e.g. from the Feats page to the Immunities page) would open the data of another creature, if the initial creature had its position modified in the list of creatures.
[*] In addition to granting or removing normal feats, a script command can now be used to [b]grant (or remove) a Cleric Domain Power[/b], Psychic Warrior Focus, Champion Sacred Emblem, Storm Warrior Tempest Path, Paladin Oath, Barbarian Spirit Animal, Rogue specialisation, Monk specialisation, Wizard Transformation, or Wizard Familiar. To do this, you can use the "[b]Set character property[/b]" command with the setting "Additional feat" or "Subtractive feat". You can then input the name of the feat or specialisation option you're interested in. The name should be exactly in the same form as when it is displayed in the Feats tab of the creature properties screen, in the Creature Editor.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

I'll post a new [b]Kickstarter Update[/b] in the next few days at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts

[b]Thank You So Much, Valiant Knights! A Bold Warrior Fears Nothing! ^_^[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.91
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.91[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

I, for one, welcome the arrival of our new insect overlord: the four-armed [b]MANTIS[/b]!

[list]
[*] Added the [b]Mantis sprite[/b] in two versions, golden and green, and updated the character-creation interface.
[*] The spell [b]Globe of Invulnerability[/b] will no longer work against the "[b]Throw Creature[/b]" action. Thank you [b]Lord Mage[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] The Barbarian's [b]Spirit Animals[/b] will no longer be marked as having a verbal and somatic component, so you'll be able to use them while holding a [b]heavy shield or tower shield[/b]. Thank you, [b]Lord Mage[/b]!
[*] Fixed the [b]proficiency category[/b] of [b]Tower Shields[/b] in the modules Augury of Chaos and Tutorial, and in the Data/BaseWeapons file.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] in combat when an enemy mage is scripted to use a summoning spell.
[*] Fixed a bug with the effect of the spell [b]Flesh to Stone[/b] causing the game to crash. This was due to an incorrect setting in the spell: "Condition petrification" instead of "Condition petrify". Thank you [b]Zent[/b]!
[*] Adjusted the position of [b]modular sprites[/b] for humans when [b]prone[/b].
[*] Fixed a centering issue with the [b]prone sprite[/b] of the [b]Pig sprite[/b].
[*] Fixed a centering issue with the [b]prone sprites[/b] of the [b]three female child sprites[/b].
[*] Added a couple of [b]tokens[/b] for a [b]Horse[/b] of size 2x2 squares.
[*] Added a new functionality to the "[b]Give item to character[/b]" and "Give droppable item" script commands so that the item can be equipped on a body slot rather than added to the character's inventory (any pre-existing item on the target body slot will be removed). To do so, you can use this example: "Longsword/Right hand". Please see the command's tooltip information in the Script Editor for more details about this.
[*] When a scripted dialogue has "[b]vo[/b]" or "[b]voiceover[/b]" in its music volume field, and an [b]ogg voiceover file[/b] is played after setting up the dialogue, once the voiceover playback is over, the music volume will now return from 50% to 100% progressively. In other words, the music volume will be reduced to 50% only while the voiceover file is being played. Also fixed an issue with these volume variations when there are several dialogues with the same music.
[*] Fixed a bug with the script command "[b]If already talked to[/b]".
[*] Fixed an issue with the script command to [b]add a companion[/b] when that character had the "Allow out-of-square position" intelligence setting.
[*] Reduced the maximum distance for [b]casting a spell out of combat[/b] on an NPC.
[*] Fixed a bug with the script command used to [b]give a condition[/b] to a creature. During combat, it would fail to remove the creature from the list of combat participants even if the condition given was "[b]Dead[/b]". This will now work - you can remove a combat participant after combat has begun.
[*] Added "[b]Leave map after running to destination[/b]" as an extra option for the script command used to set the non-combat behaviour of a creature.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "[b]Apply temple healing[/b]" script command not removing the [b]Swallow Whole[/b] condition, which would then prevent adding a swallowed target as a companion.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when a custom module uses [b]spell scrolls[/b] not named exactly as their spell. Thank you [b]Zent[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]Module Editor[/b] when a creature is holding two weapons, you remove the right-hand weapon, and mouse over the left-hand weapon.
[*] Fixed a display issue in the [b]inventory screen[/b] in the macOS version only.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

I'll post a new [b]Kickstarter Update[/b] in the next few days at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts

[b]Thank You So Much, Brave Heroes! And May the Smiling God, Apollus, Shower You With His Blessings!! :-)[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.90
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Here's Version [b]1.90[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b].

It should make the game [b]run faster[/b] during combat. It also fixes a number of [b]bugs and issues[/b], and helps with [b]module creation[/b].

[list]
[*] Added code optimisations to make the game [b]run faster[/b] particularly when starting combat on a [b]large map[/b], when a character [b]falls down[/b] over several squares, when [b]terrain spells[/b] have been used, or when mousing over [b]inaccessible squares[/b]. I had to look into this because of the huge "[b]Crossroad Castle[/b]" map featured in the upcoming module [b]The Dark Arena[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug concerning the [b]enemy AI for line and cone spells and special abilities[/b]. Also fixed a bug with the AI processing of the spell [b]Boulder Strike[/b].
[*] Mousing over the headline of the [b]Floor Items/Container Items box[/b] in the Inventory Screen will display the name of the container in the tooltip. This may be useful if the text doesn't fit within the box. Also fixed a tooltip display issue with the [b]Party Items box[/b] (that one isn't affected by pushing the space bar).
[*] Fixed a tooltip display issue when [b]mousing over an item located on an obstacle square[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue with large creatures sometimes taking [b]falling damage[/b] during their normal movement in combat when they shouldn't.
[*] Fixed an issue with large creatures incorrectly [b]threatening[/b] (or being threatened by) other creatures on a [b]different altitude[/b], due to one of the squares covered by the large creature.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when a [b]scene script[/b] adds a new combat participant who also has a scene script. Only the initial combat participants can have a scene script or defeat script; any extra scene scripts brought by additional combat participants will be ignored.
[*] For playtesting, fixed a bug with the "[b]Shift + WIN[/b]" shortcut which occurred when used after a creature has been [b]swallowed whole[/b].
[*] Improved the "[b]Event Move[/b]" script command to allow moving a character to a [b]position stored in variables[/b]. For example, you can put in the command's character field "[b]{My Character}/{Target Position X},{Target Position Y}[/b]". You can use this to have one of the party members move to a certain position, wait for a little while, and then [b]move back[/b] to his original position.
[*] Fixed display issues when a script has [b]several "Event Move" instructions in a row[/b]. Previously, the display would scroll back to the [b]party leader[/b] after each "Event Move" instruction.
[*] The script command to [b]hide or show an activable zone[/b] now has an extra option to do so without [b]updating sound and particle effects[/b] (which also resets current sound effects). For this purpose, you can select the command's new option "[b]Hidden status without effects update[/b]".
[*] [b]Images associated with activable zones[/b] will now be displayed according to [b]map colours[/b]. This means that custom map colours, set in the "[b]Edit Map Data[/b]" screen of the Module Editor, will also apply to these images.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

I'll post a new [b]Kickstarter Update[/b] in the next few days at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts

[b]Thank You So Much, Legendary Adventurers! May Your Dice Always Roll Critical! ^_^[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.89
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Here's Version [b]1.89[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b].

It brings some [b]improvements[/b] to the game and Module Editor, and fixes a bunch of [b]bugs[/b] I noticed while playtesting the upcoming adventure module [b]The Dark Arena[/b].

[list]
[*] Pushing [b]Space[/b] while the Inventory Screen is displayed will now [b]collect all of the items[/b] shown in the box for [b]Floor Items[/b] or external [b]Container Items[/b] (just as if left-clicking on the headline of the Floor Items box). Added a note about this in the Help Entry for keyboard shortcuts out of combat.
[*] Improved the [b]enemy AI[/b] for [b]Slide/Pull/Bull Rush[/b] actions on maps with elevation.
[*] Fixed bugs concerning the [b]Throw Creature[/b] action, [b]Gust of Wind[/b] spells, and [b]Knockback Arrows[/b] in maps with elevation when receiving these effects should result in your character sliding down to the lowest-altitude square.
[*] Fixed a problem with the position of [b]prone Giant Frog sprites[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]pathfinding[/b] not giving you the best path for a [b]five-foot step[/b] action when there are dangerous squares.
[*] Your characters will now be able to attack or grapple with allied characters that have received the [b]Berserk[/b] condition.
[*] In the [b]Party Creation[/b] interface, added a new check box allowing you to display [b]only the pre-generated characters[/b].
[*] Mousing over the character's class in the [b]Party Creation[/b] screen will now display the [b]Psychic Warrior Focus[/b].
[*] If you [b]summon a creature[/b] as part of your triggered [b]Ready Versus Spell[/b] action, and your summoned creature damages the interrupted caster, that caster will now have to pass a [b]concentration check[/b] for the damage received from the summon.
[*] Fixed an out-of-combat bug where your character could take [b]falling damage[/b] when clicking on an [b]adjacent activable zone[/b] or stairway.
[*] Improved the Script Editor's new "[b]Auto Fill Skilled Answer[/b]" function so that it will recognise and work with domain power skills written in the format "[b][Strength Domain][/b]" (and not just "[Domain Power Strength]").
[*] In the Module Editor, the last [b]Creature Template[/b] you've created will now appear at the bottom of the list of Creature Races in the [b]Creation Wizard[/b], and will be selected automatically when you open the Creation Wizard. Previously, it wasn't very easy to select the last template.
[*] In the Module Editor, added a new button labelled "[b]Reset All Settings[/b]" in the [b]Creation Wizard[/b] - useful when you want to do several monster creations with different classes and specialisations.
[*] The script command "[b]Add Dialog Answer[/b]" can now be set so that [b]right clicking[/b] on a line opens an associated [b]Help Entry[/b], or an associated [b]Character Sheet[/b]. (It could already be set so that right clicking would open an associated item or weapon information box). To do so, first please make sure that the "required party skill" is "Nothing". Then place a help link in the field "variable value" (e.g. @PSYCHIC_WARRIOR@, @FIRE_SPHERE@, @FAMILIAR@ for a normal Help Entry, or @Chromatic Orb@ for a spell). For a Character Sheet, place a character name in the "companion" field. For an item/weapon information box, place an item/weapon name in the "item" field.
[*] Corrected a few typos or missing words in the [b]Help Entries[/b] about Green Wizard feats, Arcane Transmutation, and Charisma uses.
[*] Gave a [b]Psychic Warrior Focus[/b] to the pre-generated character [b]Elizann[/b].
[*] Added a few [b]extra pre-generated characters[/b] (Stagranne, Sojandira, Baldrick, Tsveta).
[*] Fixed an issue with the "[b]Tactics Do not move[/b]" script command being off by one round of combat.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Second Chance[/b] spell used in the module [b]The Dark Arena[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue where the next encounter would be [b]triggered too soon[/b] after a battle, due to the position of one of the party members at the end of combat. This will now be avoided in virtually all possible situations.
[*] Fixed a bug with the incorrect [b]update on loading of the square type[/b] of a square, when that type was edited through a script (e.g. removing a Fire Damage Square).
[*] Fixed a bug with the script command "[b]Scripted Event Move Character[/b]" when this event takes place during combat.
[*] Fixed several bugs with [b]Bard Songs[/b] activated through the [b]Quickbar[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug when using the [b]Attack mouse cursor[/b] on a group that has a dialogue script.
[*] Becoming [b]Helpless[/b] (e.g. due to the Sleeping condition) will no longer prevent Strength or Dexterity [b]ability damage[/b] to the character.
[*] Fixed a headline display issue with non-energy [b]Ground Death Throes[/b].
[*] In the script editor, improved the [b]command search functions[/b] to take into account the abbreviated command names (e.g. typing "module property" will now find the right command).
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

[b]Sincerest Thanks, Brave Warriors and Wise Mages of the Realm! Rejoice!! ^_^[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.87
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Here's version [b]1.87[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b].

It's a small update intended to [b]facilitate module development[/b]. In particular, creating [b]dialogue trees with skilled dialogue options[/b] should be easier and faster thanks to a new button, and [b]playtesting[/b] these options should also be easier. Moreover, the [b]Creature Wizard[/b] should be a lot more stable now.

[list]
[*] Added a [b]new sound effect[/b] in the Sounds folder: "[b]Magic earthquake.wav[/b]".
[*] Added a [b]new button[/b] in the Module Editor that appears when adding a script instruction "[b]Add Dialog Answer[/b]". You can now click on a new button labelled "[b]Autofill Skilled Answer[/b]" after entering some text, such as "[b][Archery] My aim is better than yours, fool![/b]". The editor will then automatically set the fields accordingly. The text will be changed to "[b][Archery] [{Archery Character}] My aim is better than yours, fool![/b]", the colour will be set to [b]Dark Green[/b], the selectable type will be set to "[b]selectable if the party has the skill[/b]", the required skill will be set to the appropriate skill ("[b]Archery[/b]"), and the field for the variable that will save the skilled character name will also be set ("[b]Archery Character[/b]"). Please do check that the editor correctly filled the fields after clicking on the button, because it won't work if the skill isn't recognised.
[*] Added a new "[b][Class] All Character Skills[/b]" feat for module testing. It can be added to a character through the [b]Creature Editor[/b] within the Module Editor. This character will then unlock all dialogue options with a skill requirement.
[*] Added some [b]new script command options[/b], including one to put in a variable the comma-separated list of non-petrified/non-dead/non-away active characters, one to put in a variable the n-th element of a comma-separated string, one to put in a variable the number of elements contained in a comma-separated list, and a few additional ones related to comma-separated string manipulation. Thank you [b]Raspelzahn[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] Completed the script command "[b]Set square type[/b]" with some options that were missing.
[*] Fixed a bug when using the [b]Creature Wizard[/b] after deleting a creature template (the deleted line wasn't removed from the drop-down list of templates).
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] in the [b]Creature Wizard[/b] when creating a monster from a template that was created in the same session from a monster present on the map. That bug took me a while to fix.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when mousing over a location in the [b]World Map[/b]. Thank you so much [b]Raspelzahn[/b] for highlighting this! (Currently, the only difference between the "City Map" and "World Map" types is that travel time is taken into account on the world map, but not on the city map.)
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]Token/Sprite Selection Screen[/b] with creatures that have "None" as their Gender.
[*] Corrected small errors in three [b]summoning spells of the Druid[/b].
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

I'll post a new [b]Kickstarter Update[/b] in the next few days at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.86
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.86[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

There's an upgrade of the [b]Psychic Warrior[/b] [url=https://www.heroicfantasygames.com/FWE/Pages/FWE_Psychic_Warrior.htm]class[/url] and a bunch of bug fixes and small improvements. A [b]Big Thank You[/b] to [b]Tanner[/b] and [b]Atlesen[/b] for your helpful suggestions and feedback!

[list]
[*] Added the Psychic Warrior's "[b]Principal Focus[/b]" which must be selected at level 1 out of the following possible focuses: [b]Focus of the Juggernaut, Focus of Primal Force, Focus of Resilience, Focus of Psychokinesis, Focus of Telepathy, Focus of the Life Flow[/b], and [b]Focus of Prowess[/b]. Also updated the [b]help system[/b] with new entries, and in the Module Editor, the [b]Creature Wizard[/b] with a [b]Focus[/b] selection box. Please [b]read below[/b] if you have an ongoing game with a Psychic Warrior and you'd like to select a Focus.
[*] Added [b]three feats[/b] for the Psychic Warrior: [b]Ascendant Psychometabolism, Sublime Psychometabolism[/b], and [b]Improved Stomp[/b]. Updated the help system.
[*] Expanded the [b]Set Property[/b] script command to allow setting the [b]dynamic sprite[/b] data, as well as [b]adding feats or removing feats[/b] to or from a character using a script.
[*] Fixed a [b]bug with dangerous maps[/b] (sweltering, freezing or underwater ones). In these maps, after combat, your character could be stuck (immobile) if your party leader was [b]knocked unconscious[/b] during the battle. Thank you so much [b]Tanner[/b] for pointing me towards this issue!
[*] When [b]regrouping the party[/b] after it was divided into two groups, the pre-split party formation will be restored automatically. Previously, the party leader would get changed and you'd have to restore the leader and formation manually in the [b]Party Composition and Formation Screen[/b]. Thank you, [b]Atlesen[/b]!!
[*] Out of combat, if the party leader is a [b]flying creature[/b] and there are non-flying characters in the party, for pathfinding purposes the party leader will be processed as a non-flying creature in order to avoid leading the rest of the team into dangerous squares.
[*] Corrected a wording issue in the help entry for the [b]War Domain[/b] of the Cleric and Bishop.
[*] In the Prologue of [b]Augury of Chaos[/b], clarified [b]Garret's dialogue[/b] when the player can type in someone's name.
[*] In the Prologue of [b]Augury of Chaos[/b], Giant Spider Queen [b]Shiwang[/b] will now drop [b]two items[/b] selected at random out of her inventory when you defeat her in combat. Module Creators can now use the Creature Intelligence setting "[b]Number of random item drops[/b]" in the [b]Intelligence tab[/b] of [b]Creature Properties[/b] in the [b]Creature Editor[/b] to set a number of items to be dropped. These items will be selected at random out of all of the creature's no-drop items (items marked as loot will always be dropped).
[*] The attack tooltip for [b]Life Stealing[/b] weapons will now display the corrected range of possible values for [b]life stealing damage[/b] (the tooltip wasn't taking into account the [b]Bracers of Impact[/b] or the [b]Barbed[/b] [url=https://www.heroicfantasygames.com/FWE/Pages/FWE_WeaponEnchantments.htm]weapon enchantment[/url]).
[*] Fixed a typo in the description of the artifact wand '[b]+1 Succor[/b]'.
[*] Fixed a display problem with the [b]Party Members box[/b] in the [b]Inventory Screen[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug with the selected [b]Power Point Expense[/b] when selecting a [b]different Psionic Power[/b] in the [b]Character Sheet[/b] for characters with psionic powers.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]special selection[/b] (e.g. the energy type) when selecting a [b]different Psionic Power[/b] in the [b]Character Sheet[/b] for characters with psionic powers.
[*] Fixed a sprite display problem with [b]Gargoyles[/b] when they're [b]Prone[/b].
[*] In the [b]macOS version[/b], fixed a bug in the single-page [b]Character-Creation Screen[/b] when checking that the [b]starting feats[/b] of the character have been selected.
[/list]Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

[b]Thank You, Valiant Defenders! May Your Dice Always Roll Critical![/b] ^_^

P.S. Here's how you can give your [b]Psychic Warrior[/b] a [b]Focus[/b] in your ongoing game:

1) From the main menu, open the [b]Module Editor[/b] (selecting any module), then push "V" to open the [b]Creature Editor[/b].
2) Click on the button labelled "[b]Load creature file[/b]".
3) Navigate to the game's [b]Saves[/b] folder using the 'Parent Directory' button ([b]Windows version:[/b] click two times on Parent Directory then double click on "Saves"; [b]macOS version:[/b] you have to navigate to User/Library/Application Support/KotC 2/Saves).
4) Each saved game is a numbered folder. Double click on the folder of the saved game containing your Psychic Warrior.
5) Double click on [b]SaveChar.cml[/b] to open the character file of your saved game.
6) You now have your party members listed in the Creature Editor. Double click on your Psychic Warrior.
7) Now click on the "[b]Feats[/b]" tab of the [b]Creature Properties[/b] screen.
8) In the "[b]Feat name[/b]" dropdown box, find your [b]Focus[/b] of interest, for example: "[b][Class] Psychic Warrior Focus of Resilience[/b]".
9) Click on the button labelled "[b]Add[/b]" to add the Focus to your character (any pre-existing Focus of the character will be removed automatically).
10) Then click on [b]Okay[/b] to close the Creature Properties / Feats and Special Abilities interface.
11) Now click on the button labelled [b]Save creature file[/b].
12) Navigate again to the [b]Saves[/b] folder using the 'Parent Directory' button.
13) Select the folder of your saved game containing the Psychic Warrior.
14) Double click on [b]SaveChar.cml[/b] in order to overwrite the file with your modified file. [b]Confirm[/b] the overwrite.
15) Now you can push [b]Escape[/b] to close the Creature Editor. Then push [b]Escape[/b] to close the Module Editor.
16) Finally you can load your saved game. It should have your updated character.

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.84
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.84[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

It adds new [b]combat sound effects[/b] (including male and female and goblin sound effects), improves the [b]information tooltip[/b] when mousing over monsters, and fixes a bunch of [b]bugs[/b].

[list]
[*] The [b]information tooltip[/b] when mousing over a character or monster will now display additional information: the Armour Class, Spell Resistance, Blindsight or Darkvision status, and whether the creature has a Breath Weapon, Gaze Attack, Swallow Whole ability, or one of the three summoning Cleric Domains. Thank you [b]Tanner[/b] for the awesome suggestion!
[*] Added to the FramedIcons folder [b]two new icons representing booby traps[/b] (Mechanical_Device_Booby_Trap_Gear_Wheel_1.png and Mechanical_Device_Booby_Trap_Gear_Wheel_2.png). They can be used by module creators for when a trap is triggered, discovered or disarmed.
[*] Added to the folder "Sounds" [b]40 male and female sound effects[/b] for when the player characters and enemies are wounded or defeated.
[*] Added to the folder "Sounds" [b]18 goblin sound effects[/b] for when goblins or kobolds are struck or killed.
[*] Humanoid creatures will now have a [b]randomised wounded or killed sound[/b] playing automatically as appropriate when you fight them.
[*] Goblins and Kobolds will now have a [b]randomised wounded or killed sound[/b] playing automatically as appropriate when you fight them.
[*] In the game options under [b]'Display'[/b], added [b]two new options[/b], one to turn off wounded sound effects and the other to turn off defeated sound effects.
[*] In the module [b]Augury of Chaos[/b], added a number of new scripted sound effects (Giant Frogs in the Green Cave and the Water Shrine, Goblins around the Goblin Arena, and a death scream in Castle Gleegold's courtyard).
[*] Fixed an issue when [b]mousing over an activable zone[/b] straddling an empty square and an obstacle square. Depending on where you would click, you may get the "Unreachable" result. Now the game will find the path to the empty square.
[*] Fixed a bug with [b]unconscious characters not returning to 1 Hit Point[/b] after combat (or after receiving out-of-combat damage) when the Hit Points are exactly zero.
[*] Fixed a bug with the number of uses of the [b]Disruption Domain[/b] of the Cleric and Bishop. Thank you so much [b]Tanner[/b] for the bug report!
[*] The tooltip for the game option [b]"display HPs during combat"[/b] (used to display HPs on top of tokens) will now indicate that the option to "Display the injury status of enemies" must be turned off, for clarity.
[*] In the [b]Script Editor[/b], the [b]"search within scripts"[/b] function will now also look at the complete name of script commands. For example, you can search for "End Script If" and the results will now include all scripts containing script commands that begin with "End Script If".
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Ranger spell Lesser Magic Arrow[/b]. The spell's [b]Glue Arrow[/b] effect would give the condition Stuck, but not Entangled. I noticed this while implementing the [b]Bolas[/b], which also makes a target Stuck and Entangled.
[*] Fixed a bug on maps with [b]altitude variations[/b]. At the start of combat, depending on position, a character could receive falling damage when attacking a target for the first time.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.83
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.83[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] is here.

It adds some new features in the [b]Module Editor[/b] and fixes a bunch of bugs.

[list]
[*] Expanded the [b]altitude selector[/b] to cover altitudes between [b]+125[/b] and [b]-125[/b] in the Module Editor (up from between +100 and -100).
[*] In the Module Editor, added [b]"Add Waterfall Splash Animation"[/b] under "Other Tools". It's just a nice visual effect for waterfalls and fountains. When you select this and click on the map, it will create an activable zone named [b]"Splash Animation,70%,50%"[/b]. The first percentage is the [b]opacity[/b], the second number is the [b]scaling factor[/b]. You can also modify the number of particles and the speed of the animation by left clicking on the activable zone in the "Edit Activable Zones" mode (the animation speed will be modified by the number labelled 'hardness').
[*] Added a [b]red display for ground traps[/b] (rectangular or polygonal), similar to how traps were displayed in [b]Baldur's Gate[/b]. The effect works with activable zones named "Trap". When their 'hidden' status parameter is 0, and a script is attached to them, they will be displayed with red transparency in the game view. The script should set the hidden status to 1 after the trap has been disarmed or triggered.
[*] In the Module Editor, fixed [b]sound issues[/b] when closing a map with the Ctrl+Q hotkeys.
[*] In the Module Editor, added two new sound sources: [b]"Waterfall small"[/b] and [b]"Waterfall heavy"[/b]. For these effects, added to the Sounds folder the files "Waterfall small.wav" and "Waterfall heavy.wav".
[*] Added a couple of frog croaking sound effects into the Sounds folder: [b]"Frog toad croaking short.wav"[/b] and [b]"Frog toad croaking long.wav"[/b].
[*] In the Creature Editor, fixed a [b]display issue in the immunities tab[/b] concerning the blindness immunity and the patterns/gaze attacks immunity when the creature has blindsight.
[*] In the Creature Editor, fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when clicking on "create character using the player-character creation interface".
[*] In the Creature Editor, in the inventory tab, fixed a bug when right-clicking on a weapon or item, then pushing escape. This would [b]change the name of the weapon or item[/b], adding "_0002" at the end.
[*] In the Module Editor, fixed a bug with the [b]display of polygonal activable zones[/b] when there are more than one polygonal zones on a map. Only the first one was displayed correctly. Also fixed a bug when [b]copying a polygonal activable zone[/b] using the Control+C and Control+V shortcut keys.
[*] In the Module Editor, fixed an issue with the [b]Control+Z[/b] shortcut keys to undo the last change after trying to place an item or weapon on any obstacle squares.
[*] [b]Water-animation effects[/b] will no longer be displayed [b]beyond the boundaries[/b] of the map.
[*] Added [b]natural sorting[/b] whenever displaying a sorted list of files or names in the Module Editor. This means that, for example: "My Soundtrack 10.ogg" will come right after "My Soundtrack 9.ogg" (even though the character '1' comes before '9'), and "Goblin_Dialogue_2" will come right after "Goblin Dialogue 1" (spaces, underscores and hyphens will not be differentiated for the purpose of sorting).
[*] In the [b]macOS[/b] version, fixed the use of Left Control + Left-Click-And-Drag to [b]move activable zones[/b] in the Module Editor. Since the Control key converts left-mouse-button clicks into right-mouse-button clicks, I had to allow the use of Right-Click-And-Drag to move activable zones in the macOS version. Note: if you have problems when using the standard arrow keys in the macOS version (e.g. to resize an activable zone), please use the [b]numpad arrow keys[/b] instead.
[*] In the [b]macOS[/b] version, fixed a bug with [b]Quick Save loading[/b]. When selecting [b]Load Quick Save[/b] from the main menu or the module editor, the game would open the "select saved game" screen instead of loading the quick save directly.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

[b]Thank You So Much, Champions of Destiny! Glory Awaits!![/b]

P.S. The latest [b]Kickstarter Update[/b] can be found here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts/4301481

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.80
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.80[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

It includes a bunch of [b]bug fixes[/b], a new feat for the [b]Gladiator[/b] ([b]Shatter Image[/b]), two new feats for the [b]Samurai[/b] ([b]Shatter Image[/b] and [b]Mist Ronin[/b]), an improvement to the [b]Way of the Pillar[/b] specialisation option of the [b]Monk[/b], improvements to the feats [b]Forest Affinity[/b] and [b]Water Affinity[/b] of the [b]Ranger, Storm Warrior[/b] and [b]Druid[/b], improvements to the feats [b]Storm Weapon[/b] and [b]Improved Storm Weapon[/b] of the [b]Storm Warrior[/b], improvements to the feats [b]Improved Finger of Death[/b] and [b]Greater Finger of Death[/b] of the [b]Wizard, Sorcerer, Warlock[/b] and [b]Druid[/b], and improvements in the [b]help files[/b].

Thank you so much [b]Christoffer[/b] for all the bug reports and suggestions which helped produce this update!

[list]
[*] Added a new [b]Gladiator[/b] and [b]Samurai[/b] feat: [b]Shatter Image[/b]. This new feat should help them fight mages. Also created a new help entry for the feat.
[*] Added a new [b]Samurai[/b] feat: [b]Mist Ronin[/b]. It grants the '[b]Fog Cloak[/b]' condition to the Samurai. Also created a new help entry for the feat.
[*] The [b]Storm Weapon[/b] and [b]Improved Storm Weapon[/b] feats of the Storm Warrior will now also apply to Flaming, Flaming Burst, Frost and Icy Burst weapons. Updated and improved the help entries for the feats Storm Weapon and Improved Storm Weapon and the weapon enchantments Flaming, Flaming Burst, Frost and Icy Burst.
[*] The [b]Way of the Pillar[/b] specialisation option of the Monk will now allow you to use [b]Stunning Fist[/b] against targets that are [b]immune to both Stunning and Critical Hits[/b]. In that case, the Stunning Fist attack will apply the Slowed condition on the target instead of the Stunned condition. If the target is immune to both Stunning and the Slowed condition, the damage bonus from your Stunning Fist will increase from one time your level to 1.5 times your level rounded up.
[*] The feat [b]Forest Affinity[/b] will now also improve the spell [b]Summon Wolf[/b] from Move Action to Free Action. Also updated and improved the help entry for the feat.
[*] The feat [b]Water Affinity[/b] will now also improve the spell [b]Summon Crocodile[/b] from Move Action to Free Action. Also updated the help entry for the feat.
[*] The feat [b]Improved Finger of Death[/b] will now improve the spell [b]Finger of Death[/b] from Close Range to Long Range (up from Medium Range, previously). Also updated the help entry for the feat.
[*] The feat [b]Greater Finger of Death[/b] will now increase the damage by [b]1d6[/b] when the target resists the Death effect, in addition to making the spell Move Action. Also updated and improved the help entry for Greater Finger of Death.
[*] In the "[b]Launch Module[/b]" screen, the [b]Tutorial module[/b] will now appear as "[b]Citadel of Shadows (Tutorial Adventure)[/b]". The module's actual name and folder remain the same ("Tutorial").
[*] Improved the [b]AI[/b] for when enemies must deal with dangerous squares.
[*] Improved the [b]AI[/b] for when enemies are far away from the party members.
[*] Added some [b]optimisations[/b] to improve the speed of AI calculations.
[*] Fixed a [b]combat bug[/b] with [b]enemy mages casting multiple spells[/b] beyond the normal limit, under the Accelerated Spell condition. This could happen if the mage was blinded and the party members were affected by Acid Fog or Solid Fog, due to a variation of the acting combatant's remaining move points during AI calculations.
[*] Fixed a [b]bug with distance calculation[/b] when considering a charge going through enemy creatures with the feat [b]Graceful Charge[/b]. You move through enemies at half speed. The bug was affecting both the AI and the player.
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]walk distance display[/b] when mousing on a square during combat before moving a character. After a right click the distance was displayed as zero.
[*] Fixed a bug with [b]Berserk archers[/b] being able to use a full attack and then move as if they had the feat [b]Wade In[/b].
[*] Fixed a [b]memory bug[/b] in combat when the AI is considering a summoning spell. This could cause a crash.
[*] Fixed a [b]bug with the quickbar[/b] that could happen when the player's spell, such as Acid Fog, would also affect the caster. This could cause a crash.
[*] Fixed the [b]indigo ray[/b] of the spell [b]Prismatic Void[/b]. It was causing Confusion rather than Berserk.
[*] Fixed the [b]green ray[/b] of the spell [b]Prismatic Void[/b]. It was checking for immunity to Ability Damage rather than immunity to Acid damage only.
[*] Fixed a typo in the help entry for [b]Concealment[/b], and added a link to the [b]Fog Cloud[/b] condition.
[*] Added details in the help entries for [b]Confusion[/b] and [b]Berserk[/b]. Berserk characters with a ranged attack don't attack the nearest creature, they attack targets selected randomly.
[*] Fixed some issues with the [b]Control+A[/b] shortcut keys to launch the quick save from the Module Editor, when pressed from within the Creature Properties screen and other screens. [b]Please note:[/b] If your quick save is a saved game from the module currently being edited, pressing Control+A from a 'Creature Properties' screen will launch the quick save and open the character sheet for the creature that you were viewing in the editor. It also works from the 'Creature Inventory', 'Edit Item' and 'Edit Weapon' screens.
[*] Fixed broken links to the help entry for the feat [b]Superior Throw Creature[/b]. Also added a link to it in the entry for [b]Improved Throw Creature[/b].
[*] Fixed links to the help entry for [b]Excellent Two Weapon Fighting[/b].
[*] Fixed a help entry issue when searching for '[b]two-weapon fighting[/b]'.
[*] Added a link to the feat [b]Counterspelling Mastery[/b] in the entry about [b]Counterspell[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]display issues[/b] in the 'Feats' tab of the Character Sheet when selecting the Monk's "[b]Deflect Arrows[/b]" or the feat "[b]Improved Draw[/b]".
[*] Fixed a [b]display issue[/b] with the [b]weapon's name[/b] in attack roll and damage roll modifier lists, including the ones that you can access from the 'Attacks' tab of the Character Sheet.
[*] Added the missing help entries for the [b]Lich feats[/b] Spell Focus and Greater Spell Focus. Also improved the various '[b]Spell Focus[/b]' help entries with links to the Greater version of each one.
[*] Improved the help entries for [b]Storm Weapon[/b], [b]Improved Storm Weapon[/b], [b]Improved Elemental Weapon[/b], [b]Greater Elemental Weapon[/b].
[*] Improved the help entries for the Monk feat [b]Shattermantle Strike[/b] and the weapon enchantment [b]Shattermantle[/b].

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.78
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b] Happy Days: Version [b]1.78[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

It fixes a tonne of [b]bugs[/b] (I'm surprised I found so many at this stage). It also adds the new monster special ability [b]"Ground Death Throes"[/b], accessible from the [b]Feats & Special Abilities[/b] tab of the [b]Creature Properties[/b] screen, in the Creature Editor.

This ability produces a [b]terrain effect[/b] appearing on the squares occupied by the creature when it's defeated.

I've made it as flexible as possible by allowing absolutely [b]any type of dangerous terrain effect[/b]. That includes Fire, Cold, Electricity, Acid, Sonic, Prismatic Wall, Grease, Resilient Grease, Web, Resilient Web, Entangle, Wall of Blades, Spike growth, Quicksand, Fog Cloud, Solid Fog, Incendiary Cloud, Acid Fog, Stinking Cloud, Cloudkill, Psionic Fog, Antimagic Cloud, Darkness, Silence, Insect Plague, and Creeping Doom.

You can set the effect's parameters like the duration, the amount of damage, caster level and difficulty class. I think the ability will help creating memorable fights, as both the AI and player will get more use out of the Slide, Bull Rush, Pull, and Throw Creature actions.

[b]Notes for module creators:[/b] Please [b]import the spell entry[/b] "Ground Death Throes" into your spell list if you'd like to use this monster ability. Also, if the effect you're using is Fire, you may want to add a Fire-based Death Throes ability to the creature so that any pre-existing Web or Grease squares will be destroyed before applying the Ground Death Throes.

Finally, there are a few [b]speed optimisations[/b] and [b]combat-AI improvements[/b], and a [b]new option[/b] under 'Display' allowing you to turn off token shadows.

Feel free to check out the latest [b]Kickstarter update[/b] if you haven't already done so: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts/4238031]please click here[/url].

[list]
[*] Added the [b]"Ground Death Throes"[/b] monster ability. It can be selected in the Module Editor from the Feats tab of the Creature Properties screen.
[*] [b]Improved the AI[/b] when performing the [b]Ready Versus Spell[/b] action and a five-foot step cannot be taken.
[*] Increased the AI's [b]avoidance of Stinking Cloud squares[/b].
[*] Fixed a source of crashes in the [b]Module Editor[/b] when setting a creature group after changing the unique name of a creature in the group.
[*] Fixed a button-display bug in the [b]Script Editor[/b] in full-screen mode.
[*] Fixed a display bug with the [b]'bold text'[/b] button during dialogue when there isn't any dialogue icon.
[*] Fixed an out-of-combat bug occurring when a [b]large creature is patrolling[/b] a map out of combat.
[*] Added a [b]speed optimisation[/b] I had to implement for the execution of "Ground Death Throes" to be smooth.
[*] Fixed an out-of-combat [b]slowdown issue[/b] when walking through [b]Natural Fog squares[/b].
[*] Added a check for [b]duplicate item names or duplicate weapon names[/b] (somehow there were two copies of the Silver Garlic Amulet with the same name in the item file of [b]Salthill Adventures[/b], resulting in a slowdown issue).
[*] Added some text in the Module Editor tooltip when [b]pushing the control key[/b] in the [b]Edit NPCs[/b] mode, as you can also use it to duplicate terrain.
[*] Fixed a combat-log issue when [b]drinking a potion[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug where an enemy would move into a [b]Stinking Cloud square[/b], get the Nauseated condition, and still perform an attack immediately afterwards (in the same round), due to the game not immediately removing the creature's remaining actions for the current round.
[*] Mousing over [b]Instant Death squares[/b] in combat will now display 'Instant Death' rather than 'Blocked Path' (don't forget you can push enemies into them).
[*] Fixed a display bug in the tooltip that appears when mousing over creatures in the initiative list, when [b]displaying a readied action[/b] and no condition.
[*] Added a new game option under 'Display' allowing you to [b]turn off the outglow (shadow)[/b] around tokens. Note: if there are some transparent pixels between a token and its outglow, it's because the token graphic has some transparent pixels on its edge that should be opaque (you can use a magic-wand selection around any of the tokens of the base game to see what pixels should be opaque, simply click on the four corners using the 'add selection' mode to get the circle's edge).
[*] Added under 'Display' a duplicate line for [b]'Display The Injury Status of Enemies'[/b], which previously was only found under 'Difficulty' and that can be confusing.
[*] Fixed a problem with [b]map scrolling using the arrow keys[/b] when the map is smaller than the screen.
[*] Fixed a source of crashes when a script tries to [b]start combat[/b] with creatures that aren't visible.

[*] Fixed a combat-log display issue with [b]Death Throes[/b] and [b]Splash[/b] weapon-enchantment effects.
[*] Fixed errors and improved the help entry for the [b]Break Free combat action[/b].
[*] Fixed some issues with some [b]Spell Focus[/b] feats not being applied to the [b]Break Free Difficulty Class[/b] of Web and Entangle (e.g. Ranger Spell Focus with Ranger Web spell, Druid Spell Focus with Entangle or Fungal Parasite). The break free DC from Glue Arrow will also benefit from Ranger Spell Focus.
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]Creature Wizard[/b] associated with the [b]Mage Knight feats[/b] Spell Focus Wizard Evocation, and Greater Spell Focus Wizard Evocation.
[*] Added the spell class category [b]'Wizard [Astral]'[/b] in the spell editor (meaning a spell that could be used or learnt only by a mage without a celestial attunement).
[*] Fixed a combat bug that could occur when a character died or was knocked unconscious due to [b]moving into an Acid Fog square[/b] and depending on the result of a saving throw.
[*] Fixed a tooltip error when mousing over squares affected by the spell [b]Incendiary Cloud[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Search box[/b] of the Arcane, Divine and Psionics tabs of the Character Sheet.
[*] Fixed a bug with the damage of the psionic power [b]Psionic Fog[/b], and another bug with the combat-log display of Psionic Fog damage.
[*] Added Difficulty Class, Saving Throw chance, and expected damage information to the tooltip for [b]Creeping Doom squares[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Module Editor[/b] not indicating a change in the current map after opening the Creature Editor by clicking on a hidden creature in the "Edit NPCs" mode.

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.77
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Version [b]1.77[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed.

It adds the [b]Aviara Elf[/b] subrace, two [b]Wizard familiars[/b], and for module creators the possibility for items to be [b]cursed[/b] or [b]restricted[/b] (see details below). It also fixes a bunch of bugs and adds a saving throw bonus or penalty on [b]flying creatures[/b] for wind-based and ground-based spells.

[list]
[*] [b]New Subrace:[/b] Added a new Elf subrace, the [b]Aviara Elf[/b] (or Winged Elf), who has the ability to fly. The Aviara penalties are -2 Dex, -5 Speed, and 50% vulnerability to Sonic damage. Also updated the help entry for Elves.
[*] [b]Flying Creatures:[/b] Added a -2 Reflex saving throw penalty for non-prone flying creatures against the effect of wind-based spells (Gust of Wind, Greater Gust of Wind, Vortex of Doom, Tornado Blast, Sirocco, Whirlwind).
[*] [b]Flying Creatures:[/b] Added a +2 Reflex saving throw bonus for non-prone flying creatures against the effect of ground-based spells (Stomp, Greater Stomp, Earthquake).
[*] [b]New Familiars:[/b] Added two new Wizard familiars, the [b]Rat[/b] and the [b]Parrot[/b]. The Rat grants a +1 bonus on [b]Spell Penetration checks[/b] and the Crawling Familiar skill, while the Parrot improves your [b]Colour Spray[/b] spell and grants the [b]Rogue Pick Pocket skill[/b] and Flying Familiar skill. Also added five new 64x64 item icons for the new familiars (two for the Rat and three for the Parrot), and updated the help entry for familiars.
[*] [b]Epic Toughness Feat:[/b] The bonus from the feat [b]Epic Toughness[/b] will increase by five points if you have the [b]Toad[/b] Wizard Familiar or the [b]Toughbone[/b] Half-Giant subrace.
[*] [b]Module Editor:[/b] Added the [b]'restricted' status and 'cursed' status[/b] for weapons, armour, and other items. These can now be set in the Item Editor and Weapon Editor. The system is quite flexible. Items can now be restricted to a character class, a class specialisation (or Cleric domain), a race or subrace, a combination of race/subrace and class/class specialisation, a specific character, or a comma-separated list of any of the above. When a restricted item can't be used by a character, it will be marked with a blue square in the Inventory Screen. The character won't be able to equip the item or activate it. [b]Cursed items[/b] can't be unequipped by the player. They could be removed through a story script, or through the item's script.
[*] [b]Interface:[/b] Restricted items that can't be used or equipped by a character will be marked with a [b]blue square[/b] underneath the icon of the item, in the Inventory Screen.
[*] [b]Interface:[/b] When typing [b]special characters[/b] in multi-line text boxes, pushing one of the Alt keys will have the same effect as pushing one of the Shift keys. This may be useful for the macOS version, as I've been having trouble inputting the special characters using the Shift keys only. Also, pressing [b]Alt+M[/b] will input the question mark character.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with skill checking for the [b]Aquatic Familiar skill[/b] (Water Familiar skill) provided by [b]Toad[/b] and [b]Snake[/b] Wizard Familiars.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with a duplicate entry of the feat [b]'Widened Colour Spray'[/b] in the Help Search screen.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug in the Help Entry system when using the Help Search screen several times.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with [b]items inside a container[/b] not being activable out of combat when they should be.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a display bug in the Creature Editor when displaying [b]Centaur sprites[/b] in the Creature Properties screen. Also fixed a minor display issue in the Weapon Details screen and Item Details screen.
[*] [b]Enemy AI:[/b] Fixed a minor enemy-AI issue with [b]flying spellcasters[/b] when considering the use of a wind-based spell.
[*] [b]Help Entries:[/b] Improved the Help Entries for Intelligence, Skills and the feats Spell Penetration, Greater Spell Penetration, Epic Spell Penetration, and Spell Resistance.
[*] [b]Character Creation:[/b] Fixed a bug with [b]character sub-types[/b] (such as 'Stable') when changing the race in the single-screen character-creation interface.
[*] [b]Character Creation:[/b] Improved the display of [b]character skills[/b] during character creation.
[*] [b]Weapon Enchantment:[/b] Fixed an issue with [b]weapon icon selection[/b] when enchanting a weapon with a unique/custom icon located within the WeaponIcons folder of a module.
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly.

It fixes a bunch of bugs and adds [b]new feats for the Paladin and Gladiator[/b], the [b]Lay On Hands[/b] and [b]Scare Undead[/b] abilities of the Paladin, the [b]Paladin's Oath[/b], and new [b]sound effects[/b] for spells.

[b]Note to module creators:[/b] you'll need to paste the file [b]Modules/Augury of Chaos/Spells.sml[/b] into your module folder in order to allow Paladins to use Lay On Hands and Scare Undead. Alternatively, if your module has custom spells, please open your spell list in the Module Editor, click on [b]import[/b] to import the file Modules/Augury of Chaos/Spells.sml, and then import Lay On Hands and Scare Undead into your Spells.sml file. Thank you!

[list]
[*] Added the [b]Paladin's Oath[/b]. You select an Oath at level 1 and receive unique benefits at level [b]1[/b] and level [b]11[/b]. You can choose between the Oath of the Defender, Oath of the Hospitaler, Oath of the Avenger, Oath of Devotion, Oath against Undeath, Oath against Fiends, and Oath against Dragons.
[*] Added the [b]Paladin[/b] abilities [b]Lay On Hands[/b] and [b]Scare Undead[/b]. A big Thank You to everyone who contributed ideas and suggestions for the Paladin!
[*] Added the [b]Paladin[/b] feats [b]Extra Lay On Hands, Improved Lay On Hands, Improved Scare Undead, Fervent Faith, Widened Protection[/b].
[*] Augury of Chaos: reviewed the Paladin NPCs to give them the new Paladin abilities. Also updated the pre-generated Paladin player characters.
[*] Added the new [b]Gladiator[/b] feat [b]Superior Throw Creature[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Mage Knight's[/b] feat [b]Improved Enhance Ability[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Paladin's[/b] feat [b]Mystic Shield[/b]. Thank you for the bug report [b]Christiano[/b]!
[*] Added new sound effects for the spells [b]Boulder Strike, Fireball, Lay On Hands, Scare Undead[/b].
[*] Fixed bugs with the script commands [b]"Give HPs"[/b] and [b]"Set HPs"[/b]. Thank you so much [b]kai[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] Fixed a bug with party items that have [b]charges not getting replenished[/b] when the party rests, if the item was stored in a container.
[*] Added missing text in the help entry for [b]Halted[/b].
[*] Fixed an error concerning [b]Reach Weapons[/b] in the help entry for Weapon Groups.
[*] Fixed a [b]display bug in the Module Editor[/b], in the equipment page of the Creature Editor, when right clicking on an item and bag items were displayed.
[*] Fixed some issues in the [b]inventory screen[/b] when your backpack is full, or when using Spiked Gauntlets.
[*] Corrected an error in the text of the help entry for the [b]Light Weapon Restriction[/b] of the Mantis, and added a link to it in the entry for the [b]Mantis[/b].
[*] Added a [b]tooltip information bubble[/b] in the [b]Effects[/b] interface of the Creature Editor, saying that only permanent effects can be added in this screen (rounds-based conditions can be given through a pre-battle script). Thank you [b]Kyle[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] The alignment [b]Lawful Good[/b] will be automatically selected when creating a Paladin.
[*] Fixed some issues in the character-creation interface when choosing a [b]class specialisation option[/b] and then clicking cancel (the selected option wasn't getting reset).
[*] Fixed a bug in the character-creation interface where the Hit Points of a newly-created character would be displayed as [b]"uninjured"[/b] in the character sheet, rather than the actual number of HPs.
[/list]Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too.

[b]Thank You For Your Stalwart Support, Valiant Paladins of the Realm! Rejoice :-)[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.71
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Version [b]1.71[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed. It adds two important [b]new feats[/b], fixes lots of [b]bugs[/b], and creates new opportunities for [b]custom modules[/b] to shine!

[list]
[*] [b]New Feats:[/b] Added two new feats accessible to all the character classes: [b]Excellent Two-Weapon Fighting[/b], and [b]Graceful Charge[/b]. Graceful Charge allows you to bypass creatures when [b]charging[/b], especially if you also have the feat [b]Overrun[/b]. Very useful for all melee classes! Excellent Two-Weapon Fighting reduces or eliminates the attack-roll penalties when fighting with [b]two weapons[/b]. Great if you'd like to use two large weapons and your character isn't a [b]Fighter[/b] or [b]Gladiator[/b]! Fighters and Gladiators can receive a different benefit if they take the feat. Thank you so much [b]Kyle[/b] for these awesome feat suggestions!
[*] [b]Engine:[/b] Spells with a [b]line area of effect[/b] will now stop when hitting a tall obstacle (being defined as any square of altitude 15 ft above the origin square or higher). The reason for this change is that I've seen the AI use Lightning Bolt through castle towers, which doesn't seem right.
[*] [b]Engine:[/b] Large creatures, when squeezing, won't take [b]falling damage[/b] when one of the squares they occupy changes altitude (unless it's the creature's 'main' square, the top-left corner of the area occupied).
[*] [b]Engine:[/b] Added a few speed optimisations to accelerate the AI and gameplay.
[*] [b]Module Editor:[/b] In the Module Editor, you can now set for a module a custom (1000 * 730 pixels) [b]introduction screen[/b], a custom (1000 * 730) [b]title image[/b] that will appear on top of the introduction screen, a [b]custom music[/b] for the introduction screen, a custom music for the party-creation screen, a custom music for the character-creation screens one and two, a custom music for the character-creation screens three and four, and a custom music for the 'Escape' menu during play. Please go to your module's [b]Module Data[/b] screen to set these.
[*] [b]Module Editor:[/b] In the Script Editor, added the possibility to retrieve the [b]'Name of the item user or caster'[/b]. This allows us to have items that apply an effect or cast a spell directly on the character holding the item. Thank you so much [b]Kai[/b] for the heads up [url=https://heroicfantasygames.com/Forums/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=1278]in the forums[/url]!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with the [b]Mage Knight[/b] feat [b]Improved Shocking Grasp[/b] not improving the damage from Shocking Grasp and Greater Shocking Grasp. Thank you so much [b]Christiano[/b]!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with the [b]Wizard[/b] spell [b]Globe of Invulnerability[/b] having no effect. Thank you so much [b]Christiano[/b] and [b]frgrndrgns[/b] for the heads up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when using the [b]Delay action[/b] in large battles. Thank you [b]Christiano[/b] for the bug report!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] When creating a [b]Rogue[/b] character, the game will now require you to select a [b]Rogue specialisation[/b]. Thank you [b]Christiano[/b] for the heads up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with the [b]Cleric/Bishop[/b] feat [b]Fast Touch Domain Powers[/b]. Thank you so much [b]Christiano[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that occurred whenever a script command would remove from a [b]dual-wielding character[/b] his or her main-hand weapon. Thank you [b]Kyle[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug with the spell [b]Produce Flame[/b] not getting empowered when cast by [b]Fire Druids[/b]. Thank you [b]Christiano[/b] for the heads-up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed errors associated with the feat [b]Epic Overrun[/b].
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Fixed a graphics issue associated with [b]Dwarf paperdoll images[/b].
[*] [b]Augury of Chaos:[/b] Added a line in the Quest Journal entry for the quest of the [b]Vanishing Sword[/b] highlighting the fact that if you go to any location not leading you towards the sword, the quest will be marked as cancelled. Thank you [b]Kyle[/b]!
[*] [b]Help Entries:[/b] Improved the in-game description of the spell [b]Halt Undead[/b] and, in the help entry for [b]magic weapons[/b], added a note saying that you need at least a [b]+1 enhancement value[/b] on a weapon or armour in order to enchant the item with other enchantment types like [b]Flaming[/b].
[*] [b]Weapon/Armour Enchantment:[/b] In the weapon and armour enchantment interface, a note [b]'+1 Required'[/b] will appear when the selected item hasn't yet received any enchantment. Thank you so much [b]Kyle[/b] for the heads up!
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too.

[b]Thank You So Much For Your Support, Fearless Heroes of the Realm! Enjoy :-)[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.70
notes.content:
[b]Axes High![/b] Version [b]1.70[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] celebrates our worthy friends, the [b]Mighty Dwarves[/b]! Join the party, everyone's invited! ^_^

[list]
[*] [b]New Feats:[/b] Added [b]two new feats for Dwarves[/b]: '[b]Giant Hunter[/b]' and '[b]Shieldbearer[/b]'.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Added [b]modular Dwarf sprites[/b], complete with a selection of beards, Dwarven armour, and Dwarven shields and weapons, including magical ones! Potentially, you could also use the Dwarf sprites for a Half-Giant character, by setting the character's height above 100%.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Reworked the [b]Character-Creation Interface[/b] so that the first choice you make is the character's race, and selecting a race/subrace/gender will automatically set the character's physical appearance to something appropriate for that race. [*] [b]Enemy AI:[/b] Enemy archers won't use '[b]Rapid Shot[/b]' when they don't have enough arrows left to benefit from it.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug when [b]changing the name of a weapon or armour[/b] in the inventory screen. The item would disappear after changing the name.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] [b]Psychic Healers[/b] of level 1 that have the feat [b]Healing Focus[/b] will now be able to activate the power [b]Cell Division[/b]. The game wasn't taking into account your feats when checking the caster level of a psionic power. Thank you so much Kyle for the bug report!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] When launching a new module starting on a [b]map containing no activable zones at all[/b], there was still a source of crashes. This is now fixed. Thank you Kyle for the heads-up!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue with [b]ambient sound sources[/b] associated with a hidden activable zone.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when an enemy character with multiple ranged attacks only has one arrow left in his ammunition slot and starts his round using a full attack to shoot. The game would crash after processing the first shooting attack, due to an empty ammunition slot. Thank you so much Steve for letting me know about this bug!
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug concerning the [b]energy damage reductions[/b] of characters when swapping items in the inventory screen. This was a potential source of crashes and memory corruption.
[*] [b]Pregen Chars:[/b] The [b]Dwarf pre-generated characters[/b], Griswack and Belissaria, now have a Dwarf sprite, and the [b]Drake pre-generated characters[/b], Haphel and Cromwall, now have a wing sprite.

[*] [b]Help Files:[/b] In the Help Entries for the conditions '[b]Enlarged[/b]' and '[b]Reduced[/b]', added a line indicating that the change in damage rolls does not apply to your Natural Weapons (claws, bite, etc). Also improved the formatting for the Help Entries of the Feats [b]Oversized Two-Weapon Fighting[/b] and [b]Overrun[/b].
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too.

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.65
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Here's version [b]1.65[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b]. Here's the list of changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed a source of crashes[/b] that could occur infrequently when launching a game.
[*] [b]Fixed a bug[/b] that could occur when loading the [b]Settings file[/b].
[*] [b]Fixed a bug[/b] in the Module Editor with the button [b]'Apply Image Size'[/b], in the box that appears when entering data about an activable zone.
[*] [b]Added 'depth-sorted' activable zones[/b]. You can now have zones containing an image (a statue, a pool, etc) that will be displayed in the right order so that characters in front of the object will be displayed on top of the object and characters behind the object will appear behind the object. When entering the name of the activable zone, simply add [b]',Sorted'[/b] so that the object will use depth sorting. Otherwise, the images are printed below characters by default, or above characters if you add [b]',Overlay'[/b] to the name of the activable zone.
[*] Pushing the [b]H[/b] key in the editor and keeping it pressed will hide the images contained in Sorted zones. This may be useful if you want to align the Sorted image with the backdrop image underneath, for example if you have a barrel as Sorted zone and the backdrop also has the barrel image and you want them to be in the same area. Press [b]Tab[/b] and then repeatedly press [b]H[/b] to see if your zone is perfectly aligned.
[*] When moving and resizing activable zones in the Module Editor, pushing the [b]right control key[/b] instead of the left control key will hide the tooltip text.
[*] In the Module Editor, [b]fixed a source of crashes[/b] when you have several maps sharing the same background image.
[*] In the Module Editor box designed to [b]edit Activable Zone data[/b], when the cursor is in the 'HP/Nb.Particles' input box, pressing the [b]Tab[/b] key will now move the cursor to the next input box, 'Hardness/Max.Size'. Pressing [b]Tab[/b] again will return the cursor to the 'HP/Nb.Particles' box. Pressing [b]Tab[/b] while the cursor is in one of the 'Position' input boxes will also switch between the input boxes for the x and y position, and pressing [b]Tab[/b] while the cursor is in one of the 'Size' input boxes will switch between the input boxes for horizontal and vertical size.
[*] In the Module Editor, [b]ambient sound effects[/b] will now be playing.
[*] [b]Added a new sound source: Lightning field[/b]. This ambient sound source can be placed anywhere on a map easily using the menu of the Module Editor.
[*] [b]Added a new animation for vertical lightning[/b]. This effect can be placed anywhere on a map easily using the menu of the Module Editor. There are two parameters, the first one is the opacity percentage and the second one is the scaling factor. Zones are named like this: [b]'Lightning Animation,100%,50%'[/b].
[*] For the [b]moving-water animation[/b], you can now set the scaling factor. Zones are named like this: [b]'Water Animation,70%,60%'[/b]. The first number is the opacity, the second one is the scaling factor. You can now have a moving-water effect even on small rivers.
[*] Fixed an issue with terrain conditions like [b]'Fog Cloud'[/b]. The game wasn't removing them from the Character Sheet after the end of combat (although they would get removed at the start of the next fight).
[*] Added a mention of the new editor features in the [b]help entry for the Module Editor[/b].
[/list]
