notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.63
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] I hope you're well. Here's version [b]1.63[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b]. It's a small update. Here's the list of changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]'auto-add actions'[/b] feature of the [b]'Set Dialog'[/b] command in the [b]Script Editor[/b]. In version 1.62, actions would be added automatically even when you're only editing an existing script line, not adding a new one.
[*] Fixed a bug that could occur in the [b]Module Editor[/b] when changing something in the [b]Edit Map Data[/b] screen. This would happen only if you played the game before launching the editor.
[*] Fixed [b]display bugs[/b] in full-screen mode when environmental effects such as [b]fog[/b] are displayed on a map that is smaller than the screen. Thank you so much [b]Dorateen[/b] for letting me know about this bug and about the one with 'auto-add actions'! Be sure to check out Dorateen's module [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/knightsofthechalice2/mods/5]Hearkenwold[/url] if you haven't already done so. There's also a [url=https://www.heroicfantasygames.com/Forums/viewtopic.php?f=9&t=995]forum thread[/url] for the module.
[*] Added [b]three new environmental sound effects[/b] that can be placed on any map using the Module Editor: [b]Ship wood creaking[/b], [b]Sea waves[/b], and [b]Seagulls[/b]. These should be a great addition for any map featuring a boat, beach, harbour or large river. In the Module Editor, you'll find them in the menu under [b]'Other Tools'[/b] and then under [b]'Add Sound Sources'[/b].
[/list]
Separately, I've finished working on a new [b]large isometric background image[/b] for a [b]mountain map[/b] that will be used in the upcoming adventure module, [b]The Dark Arena[/b]. I'll present it in the next [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url], coming soon. I think that's the last one of the big maps I wanted to work on for The Dark Arena. I have a few more maps to do, but they will be smaller.

I'm mostly focusing on [b]The Dark Arena[/b] now, but rest assured, I'll keep on improving the base game and particularly the [b]graphics[/b], as promised.

Meanwhile, please feel free to [b]spread the word[/b] about the [b]KotC 2[/b] goodness to [b]RPG newcomers[/b] -- meaning people who only know [b]Baldur's Gate 3[/b]. Thank you!!

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too.

[b]Thank You For Your Support, Dauntless Knights of the Realm! Best Regards ^_^[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.62
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] I hope you're well. Here's version [b]1.62[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b]. It's a small update. It includes a new [b]Fog Effect[/b] as well as [b]Script Editor[/b] improvements. 

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

The latest [b]Kickstarter update[/b] can be [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts/3820201]found here[/url]. It has a bunch of nice [b]preview screenshots[/b].

[b]Thank You So Much For Your Support, Fearless Knights and Wise Mages! Enjoy! ^_^[/b]

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.62[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the new [b]Fog Effect[/b] in the Module Editor. You can change the parameters of a map's fog (speed, angle, opacity, frequency) in the [b]Edit Map[/b] screen of the Module Editor.
[*] In the module [b]Augury of Chaos[/b], added the new [b]Fog Effect[/b] to the maps of [b]Finchbury[/b] and [b]Ruined Village[/b].
[*] Fixed some issues with the [b]text size[/b] for the information displayed when [b]mousing over a creature in combat[/b].
[*] Added [b]new script commands[/b] to set a creature's [b]sprite[/b], or record a creature's [b]token[/b], [b]sprite[/b], or [b]square size[/b]. Also fixed some issues with the script command that sets a creature's [b]token[/b].
[*] Added a [b]new script command[/b] allowing the module creator to [b]override the player's display mode selection[/b] - tokens or animated sprites - for a while.
[*] Added [b]new script commands[/b] to record or set a creature's [b]immunities[/b]. For any of the immunities, you can choose between normal, immunity, resistance 25%, resistance 50%, resistance 75%, reverse, vulnerability 25%, vulnerability 50%, vulnerability 75%, or vulnerability 100%.
[*] Fixed an issue in the [b]Script Editor[/b] with the << [b]Auto-add 'Add Answer' and 'Display Dialog'[/b] >> feature associated with the [b]Set Dialog[/b] command. The editor wasn't displaying the automatically-added lines. You had to click on [b]'Refresh'[/b] to display them and if you didn't, the Script Editor could crash afterwards. Also, that feature will now work even when the 'Auto-add' checkbox is not currently being displayed (depending on the editor's currently displayed screen, the 'Auto-add' checkbox could be hidden when you click on 'Okay' to add the Set Dialog command to your script).
[*] Fixed an issue with the [b]Shift + WIN[/b] shortcut keys that can be used to end combat. Sometimes, when pressing these keys, the game would skip all of the monsters, including those that are supposed to join the fight in later rounds. Now it will only skip the current monsters and you'll have to press the keys again if there are additional monsters coming in subsequent rounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.61
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you're well. Here's version [b]1.61[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b]. It's quite a big update. Yay!!

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

The main changes are new [b]background images[/b] during Character Creation, new [b]goblin sprites[/b] that may also be used for player characters, new [b]ooze sprites[/b], new [b]animated banners[/b], some [b]encounter tweaks[/b], improvements in the [b]Equipment Screen[/b] of the Module Editor, and [b]bug fixes[/b] including three fixes for stuff that could cause a crash. See below for details.

I'll post a new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url] soon.

[b]Thank You So Much For Your Support, Valiant Heroes of the Realm! Enjoy! ^_^[/b]

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.61[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when [b]Pizarra joins your party[/b] after the battle in the High Sewers, when you've used the option providing a Giant Spider ally during the battle and you finish the battle with the spider as the acting combatant. Also, the spider's sprite will now [b]face the party leader[/b] at the end of the fight.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] in combat which was actually due to AI processing when a large creature is [b]squeezing[/b], or will be squeezing to avoid terrain magic effects like a Stinking Cloud.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] in the [b]Module Editor[/b] when opening a module.
[*] Added a number of [b]code and memory optimisations[/b] to improve speed.
[*] In Augury of Chaos and the Tutorial Adventure, [b]tweaked a bunch of encounters[/b] where mages should have auto-casting spells like [b]Mirror Image[/b] on (but didn't have them on previously). Also gave the auto-casting Mirror Image to a bunch of Rogues and Assassins.
[*] Fixed [b]missing weapon and armour proficiencies[/b] for about 40 creatures in Augury of Chaos and about 20 creatures in the Tutorial Adventure.
[*] Using recent artwork from Pioneer Valley Games (PVGames), added a bunch of nice [b]background images[/b] to the [b]Character Creation[/b] and [b]Change Token / Sprite[/b] interfaces. There are eight backgrounds and the game selects one based on your character's class.
[*] Using recent artwork from PVGames, added [b]modular goblin sprites[/b], meaning goblin sprites that can have a specific body type, armour type, and weapon, including magic weapons. They're mostly intended to be used as monsters (particularly in the upcoming module [b]The Dark Arena[/b], as your characters will be low level for quite a while), but you can use them for your player characters too, by selecting [b]'Goblin 1-7'[/b] in the [b]'Body'[/b] dropdown box during Character Creation, or anytime using the [b]Change Token / Sprite[/b] screen within the [b]Character Sheet[/b]. You might like to use the new sprites for your Kobold characters.
[*] Using recent artwork from PVGames, added [b]new sprites[/b] for [b]Gelatinous Cubes[/b] and [b]Slimes[/b].
[*] [b]Updated a number of oozes and goblins[/b] in Augury of Chaos and the Tutorial Adventure using the new sprites. Also tweaked some encounters with oozes in Augury of Chaos. Also tweaked some goblin and kobold encounters in Finchbury.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]penalties incurred for wearing armour[/b] for which you lack the appropriate proficiency. The penalty reduction of Masterwork Armour was applied two times.
[*] Fixed the [b]position of the magic animations[/b] that are displayed when drinking a potion or casting spells, when characters are displayed using sprites.
[*] Fixed issues with the [b]Prone sprite[/b] of the [b]Hill Giants[/b] that you fight during the battle with Pizarra in the High Sewers.
[*] Fixed a display issue with [b]blood stains[/b] when rain is affecting map colours.
[*] Created a [b]swaying banner animation[/b] for the map of Crossroad Castle (in the upcoming module The Dark Arena) and other maps. Added a new [b]menu option in the Map Editor[/b], under 'Other Tools' (below 'Add Isometric Lights'), allowing you to place the new animated banners anywhere on a map easily. Also added one such banner to the map of Finchbury (atop the village's tower).
[*] Improved the [b]Equipment Screen[/b] of the [b]Module Editor[/b] so that it now displays a red square underneath weapons and armour for which the creature lacks the appropriate proficiency.
[*] Improved the [b]Equipment Screen[/b] of the [b]Module Editor[/b] so that the [b]tooltip[/b] now displays the same information that you get from within the game, including [b]Armour Class[/b] details for any armour item, or [b]Attack Roll[/b] details for any weapon. You can also use the tooltip to compare weapons and armour for the current creature, as the tooltip will display information on both the worn item and the backpack item.
[*] In the [b]Creature Properties[/b] screen of the [b]Module Editor[/b], right clicking on the [b]selected class[/b] will now open the help entry for that class.
[*] In the [b]Module Editor[/b], tiny [b]status icons[/b] will now be displayed even for hidden creatures, if the option to display these icons out of combat is activated.
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]Module Editor[/b] where a map would be saved with [b]dark colours[/b] if the editor was displaying the [b]rain effect[/b] at the moment you're saving the map.
[*] In the [b]Creature Template Editor[/b], added to the tooltip a line saying that you can right click in order to select the moused-over creature in the Map Editor (as I keep forgotting about that feature).
[*] In the [b]macOS version[/b] only, fixed a bug in the [b]tooltip display of Psionic Power Points[/b] when mousing over creatures that have Power Points.
[*] In the [b]macOS version[/b] only, added the missing [b]'Add Isometric Lights'[/b] option of the [b]Map Editor[/b], under 'Other Tools'.
[*] In the [b]macOS version[/b] only, fixed a bug with duplicate entries in the [b]'Body'[/b] dropdown box during [b]Character Creation[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.60
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you're well. Version [b]1.60[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] has landed. It's a small update.

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

Recently, I purchased the [b]epic music collection[/b] Humble Bundle from composer [b]Joel Steudler[/b]. It's still available at https://www.humblebundle.com/software/epic-royaltyfree-music-collection-software . I'm planning to use some of that music in the upcoming adventure modules.

Also, I've had a chance to make use of and participate in the [b]Stable Horde[/b] project. It's a network of volunteers who combine their computing power to generate [b]AI images[/b]. There's a web user interface at https://aqualxx.github.io/stable-ui . I was able to create some nice images as well as create a [b]Stable Horde worker[/b].

The interesting thing is that I could produce some images of size [b]1,920 x 1,920 pixels[/b], which is really big for current AI image generation. It does cost a lot of [b]Kudos[/b] to do so. Kudos is the virtual currency you earn by running a [b]Stable Horde worker[/b] on your computer, or by rating a bunch of AI-generated images through the web user interface.

Smaller images (e.g. 704 x 704 pixels) can be made for free.

Kudos can be transferred to other users from here: https://stablehorde.net/transfer or through the Discord channel: https://discord.gg/3DxrhksKzn . If you'd like to [b]contribute[/b] some Kudos for me to use in [b]dungeon map creation[/b], feel free to send them to my user ID: [b]StableDragon#18923[/b] . Thank you!!

KotC 2 version 1.60 includes the [b]alternative system for displaying huge adventure maps[/b]. That new system was presented in the latest [b]Kickstarter Update[/b]: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts/3770416


Here is how the new system works. Say you have a JPG or PNG background image of size 13,000 x 10,000 pixels. First, you need to create a [b]small-size preview version[/b] of that image. The preview image could be of size 2,000 x 1,538. It should be named like this: [b]MapName_13000_10000_Preview.jpg[/b]. That means you have to append the width and height of the original map and the word 'Preview'. Place the preview image in the [b]MapBackdrops[/b] folder of your module.

Next, within that same folder create a new folder called [b]MapName_13000_10000[/b]. Inside that folder place the 512 x 512 images that constitute the original image. These images should be named like this: [b]Base_y_x.jpg[/b], x and y being the coordinates of each chunk inside the original image, starting from zero. You can also have an overlay image. Simply place in the same folder the 512 x 512 images that constitute the overlay image. These images should be named like this: [b]Overlay_y_x.png[/b].

Finally, in the [b]Map Data[/b] screen of the Module Editor, you can set the preview image as the map's background. The game will then see that it's an image made up of a number of tiles.

To create the tiles, you can use [b]Image Magick[/b]: https://imagemagick.org/index.php . I've used the following Image Magick commands.

[b]For the base image:[/b] magick convert base.png -crop 512x512 -set filename:tile "%[fx:page.y/512]_%[fx:page.x/512]" +repage +adjoin -quality 90 "Base_%[filename:tile].jpg"
[b]For the overlay image:[/b] magick convert overlay.png -crop 512x512 -set filename:tile "%[fx:page.y/512]_%[fx:page.x/512]" +repage +adjoin "Overlay_%[filename:tile].png"

[b]Thank You So Much, Fearless Warriors and Wise Mages of the Realm! Rejoice! :-)[/b]

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.60[/b]

[list]
[*] In the [b]macOS[/b] version only, fixed a source of crashes when [b]selecting psionic powers[/b]. My sincere apologies for that bug!
[*] Fixed several display problems in the [b]Local Map screen[/b].
[*] Fixed a problem with special effects like [b]Rain[/b] and [b]Snow[/b] getting reset after talking with NPCs (at the end of a script's execution, actually).
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]double clicking[/b] during character creation. When double-clicking on a spell icon to select it, the double click for the last spell could result in the unwanted opening of the help entry for spells.
[*] Added a note in the help entries for [b]Weapon Group Proficiency Reach Weapons[/b] and [b]Natural Reach[/b] to clarify that the benefit of [b]Reach[/b] does not apply to [b]Touch Attacks[/b]. The Flux domain power and the specialisation feats of attuned Wizards and Sorcerers can transform certain touch spells into close-range spells. It may be a problem if you could get a better range for touch-range spells just by wielding a reach weapon. It would also be a problem for the AI.
[*] In the Module Editor, pressing the [b]Left Alt key[/b] will now [b]hide the backdrop image[/b] so that it's easier to see if there are any special tiles, or overlay graphics, at any particular place on the map.
[*] In the Module Editor, fixed an issue with the display of [b]long file paths[/b] in selection boxes.
[*] In the Module Editor, fixed an issue with [b]memory management[/b] when closing a map.
[*] Added some code to [b]clear previous images[/b] when loading a map image fails due to low memory.
[*] Implemented the alternative system for [b]displaying huge adventure maps[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.59
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you're well. Version [b]1.59[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b] is here. It's a small bug-fixing update.

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.58
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here is version [b]1.58[/b] of [b]Knights of the Chalice 2[/b]. It's a small update.

Please [b]see below[/b] if you're interested in the new [b]Wounded Script[/b] and [b]Turn Script[/b] for module design.

Thank you so much [b]Dorateen[/b] for updating the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/knightsofthechalice2/mods/5]Hearkenwold adventure[/url] and for uploading a new [b]video[/b] of Hearkenwold showcasing the new [b]special effects[/b]! Here is the video's link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KmV57Ulsd-8
Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

I'll post a new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url] soon.

[b]Thank You So Much For Your Support, Valiant Heroes of the Realm! Best Regards :-)[/b]

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.58[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the following options in the Game Options screen, under Display: [b]limit weather effects to map boundaries, allow map colour changes due to rain, allow rain special effects, allow snow special effects, allow falling-leaves special effects, allow will-of-the-wisp (glows) special effects, allow fog special effects[/b]. Also updated the in-game help entry for game options.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] when moving the party with the [b]numpad keys[/b] and the destination square exceeds the map's boundaries.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]recording of game time[/b]. This would result in the display of an incorrect game time when loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed [b]bugs with the weather effects[/b] when the frequency is set as [b]'always'[/b] for any of them.
[*] The combat-action tooltip for the [b]Elephant Spirit Animal[/b] Sonic Breath Weapon will now indicate that it is indeed the Elephant Spirit Animal, and not another type of breath weapon.
[*] Added the code required for the execution of scripts that are triggered in combat [b]when a creature is wounded or damaged[/b]. You can set a creature's [b]Wounded Script[/b] in the [b]intelligence tab[/b] of the [b]Creature Properties[/b] screen, within the Creature Editor. Examples of use of the [b]Wounded Script[/b]:
1) The Wizard [b]Zarx[/b] is essentially invulnerable until the player has done a specific thing such as destroy a mirror or a jar. After each hit, he recovers lost Hit Points and a Vrock is summoned (up to five).
2) The Necromancer [b]Eldark[/b] has linked his body with that of a bunch of slaves using a sinister ritual. Each non-fatal hit on the Necromancer kills one of the slaves and heals the Necromancer (as with a casting of the spell Heal).
3) [b]Garock[/b] the Barbarian will taunt the player the first time he receives a hit, shouting 'That's the best you can do?' or 'Oooh, a mosquito bite!'.
[*] Added the code required for the execution of scripts that are triggered in combat [b]at the start of the turn of a creature[/b]. You can set a creature's [b]Turn Script[/b] in the [b]intelligence tab[/b] of the [b]Creature Properties[/b] screen, within the Creature Editor. Example of use of the [b]Turn Script[/b]: at the start of her turn, the Cleric [b]Llagotha[/b] will call upon Chaotic Evil deity [b]Hexdra[/b] for assistance if her Hit Points have dropped below 55% of the maximum, or if half of her allies have been defeated. She won't be able to do it if she's sleeping, fascinated, stunned, dazed, affected by hideous laugher, etc. With the [b]Turn Script[/b], you don't need to check for these conditions within the script itself, as the Turn Script for a character will only be executed when that character can act normally. You do need to track whether the script was executed before if you don't want the script to be executed multiple times.
[/list]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.57
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you're well. Here is the latest version of [b]KotC 2[/b].

It fixes a bunch of bugs and adds the following: an option to [b]reduce the walk speed[/b], an option to [b]display the mouse cursor while moving items[/b] in the Inventory Screen, new [b]moving-water special effects[/b] (you'll have to [b]activate that option under 'Display'[/b] in the Game Options screen), and [b]four types of weather special effects[/b].

Please don't hesitate to email me at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] if you find any [b]bugs and annoyances[/b], so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] may be very helpful, too. Thank you!!

I'm very glad to report that [b]Knights of the Chalice 2: Augury of Chaos[/b] has obtained the [b]Second Place[/b] in the [b]RPG Codex Game Of The Year 2022[/b] poll: [url=https://rpgcodex.net/content.php?id=12147]https://rpgcodex.net/content.php?id=12147[/url]

Both [b]Elden Ring[/b], the winner of the poll, and [b]KotC 2[/b] received [b]75%[/b] of positive votes. Elden Ring obtained a score of [b]3.81[/b] while KotC 2 obtained a score of [b]3.74[/b].

I think that's an awesome result! [b]Thank you so much to everyone who voted in the RPG Codex poll!![/b]

Also thank you very much [b]Dorateen[/b] for letting me know about the result!

I'll post a new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url] soon.

[b]Thank You So Much For Your Support, Mighty Warriors And Wise Wizards! Best Regards :-)[/b]

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.57[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new [b]moving water animation effect[/b], which is applied in the Module Editor using a new menu option under 'Other Tools'.
[*] Added a new option in the Game Options screen, under Display, allowing you to activate or deactivate the display of moving-water animations. Please note: New players should have the option turned on by default, but [b]existing players will have to click on this option in order to display the effect[/b].
[*] Implemented the weather special effects [b]Rain, Falling Snow, Falling Leaves, and Glows (Will-of-the-wisps)[/b]. A map can have both rain and snow happening from time to time (one after the other, randomly and according to the duration settings specified in the Map Data screen). Actually, a map can have all of the four effects. All four effects can be turned off by the player by switching off the game option '[b]Display Environmental Particles[/b]' under 'Display' in the Game Options screen.
[*] [b]Updated most of the maps of Augury of Chaos[/b] to add weather effects and moving-water effects. The updated maps are: Green Cave, Red Cave, Finchbury, Ruined Village, Gleegold Keep, Mysterious Cave, Moon Crypt Special Level (Furnace), Water Shrine, Low Sewers, High Sewers, Oubliette. Also updated the Tutorial Adventure. Also added a few [b]Slope squares[/b] with altitude 5 on the map of Finchbury. You might use them when fighting.
[*] In the Module Editor, added to the [b]Map Data screen[/b] a bunch of input boxes dedicated to the new weather effects. You can use the [b]Tab key[/b] to switch from one box to the next.
[*] Added a new game option '[b]Display Cursor When Moving Items[/b]', available under 'Display' in the Game Options screen. If you find moving items in the Inventory Screen somewhat difficult, this new option will help you. Thank you very much [b]Steve[/b] for this great suggestion!!
[*] Added a new game option '[b]Adjust Walk Speed Out Of Combat[/b]' under 'Gameplay' in the Game Options screen. You can use it to reduce or increase the out-of-combat walking speed of your characters. Thank you for the suggestion, [b]Steve[/b]!
[*] In the Game Options screen, dragging one of the [b]volume sliders[/b] will no longer affect the other sliders if you mouse over them.
[*] Fixed a bug in the display of the [b]Local Map[/b] for some map sizes or screen sizes, due to fractional position values.
[*] Fixed some issues with creature orientation after a [b]Bull Rush[/b] or [b]Pull[/b] combat manoeuvre.
[*] Fixed some issues with screen scrolling when performing a [b]Throw Creature[/b] combat action.
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]combat shortcuts using the Shift key[/b] not working when pressed while mousing over the Combat Actions menu or other controls.

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.54
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here is the latest version of [b]KotC 2[/b].

It's mainly a [b]bug-fixing update[/b]. However, there are a few [b]new features[/b].

You can now [b]buy back[/b] the items that you've sold to merchants. You can use a new [b]White Robe sprite[/b] for your characters. The animation for the spell [b]Turn Pebble to Boulder[/b] was improved.

In coming weeks and months, I expect to be focusing a lot more on the [b]upcoming adventure modules[/b].

I'll keep on improving the base game, of course, but probably not with the same update frequency as before (unless we find more bugs).

I'll post a new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url] soon.

If you find any bugs or annoyances in [b]KotC 2[/b] version [b]1.54[/b], please drop me a line at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] would be very useful, too. Thank you!!

If something doesn't work, please remember that you can also revert to the [b]previous version[/b] of [b]KotC 2[/b] using the [b]Steam or GOG interface[/b].

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.54[/b]

[list]
[*] When you sell something, the item will now appear in the trader's inventory in case you'd like to [b]buy it back later[/b].
[*] The script command [b]'Give item to character'[/b] can now be used to [b]give trader NPCs more than 16 items[/b]. So, you can now have a shop with many items, but you'll have to use a script in order to add any items above the initial 16 which can be placed directly in the editor through the NPC's Inventory tab in the Creature Properties screen. Note: a single script command can be used to give multiple items to a character.
[*] Fixed some issues when trying to [b]sell a bag[/b] or coffer containing items, or a stack of gold coins, to a trader NPC.
[*] Fixed a bug that would happen after buying an item from an NPC if the NPC's dialogue was supposed to continue after opening the Trading Screen.
[*] Fixed bugs when using [b]Shift + B[/b] (or shift + click on item) to buy five items in one go from a trader NPC, when fewer than five units of the moused-over item are available, or when mousing over a non-stackable item such as a weapon.
[*] The shortcut keys to buy five items in one go (Shift + B or Shift + click on item) will now work with both the [b]Left Shift key[/b] and the [b]Right Shift key[/b]. Also, when buying five items in one go, the item's sound effect will be played only once (not five times).
[*] Improved the script command [b]'Set quest text'[/b] which you can use to set quest descriptions in the player's Quest Journal. I've added a new option: 'Append text only if the description does not already contain this text'. If you want to use the journal to record clues obtained from various sources, this option will be useful as the Quest Journal will only be updated when something new needs to be added to the Quest Journal. I'll surely make use of it for the upcoming modules.
[*] Added the [b]White Robe sprite[/b] for your characters, and for module creators who want to create new robes, perhaps with healing powers. To let your character wear the White Robe, open his or her Character Sheet, then left click on the character's token image in the top-left corner of the screen in order to open the 'Please Select Token / Sprite' screen for your character. Then, in the first dropdown box from the top, select [b]'Silver Robe'[/b]. Make sure that the option to 'Create Sprite Automatically' is ticked. Then click Okay. The Silver Robe matches the [b]white wings[/b] quite nicely. It's good for [b]Angel NPCs[/b], too.
[*] In the Combat Log, when displaying the Armour Class list of modifiers, clicking on the line [b]'Negated Dexterity Bonus to Armour Class'[/b] was opening the help entry for Armour Class. Now it will open the help entry for 'No Dexterity bonus to AC'.
[*] Improved the help entries for the [b]Grapple[/b] combat action and the [b]Grappling[/b] condition.
[*] Given the size category [b]'Small'[/b] to all of the [b]Giant Rats[/b] and [b]Dire Rats[/b] in Augury of Chaos and the Tutorial Adventure. Previously, they were Medium-size creatures.
[*] Improved the [b]projectile animation[/b] of the spell [b]'Turn Pebble to Boulder'[/b] and added [b]four boulder images[/b] to the list of item images that can be presented during scripted dialogues. They can also be selected when creating a new spell.
[*] In the [b]Tutorial Adventure[/b], added some text to the dialogue displayed just before the [b]final battle[/b]. The text lets the player know that he or she can now use the party's resources with abandon.
[*] Characters will now lose the [b]True Strike[/b] condition after launching a combat manoeuvre or grapple action.
[*] When a creature attempts a [b]grapple[/b] against a character with the [b]True Strike[/b] condition, the character will no longer benefit from the +20 bonus on the opposed grapple check. Likewise, when a creature attempts a [b]Sunder, Disarm or Feint[/b] action against a character with the True Strike condition, the character will not receive +20 on the opposed attack roll.
[*] Fixed problems with large creatures being able to target [b]out-of-reach characters[/b] when [b]squeezing[/b] near walls (or characters being able to target out-of-reach squeezing monsters). For that, I had to create a new condition, [b]'Squeezing'[/b]. A really tough thing to fix - I had to do a tonne of tweaks. Hopefully, I didn't introduce new bugs because of that. Time will tell. The [b]Giant Spider Queen[/b] in the High Sewers is one example of a creature that may often be squeezing near walls, because she's so big.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]field of view[/b] of creatures occupying more than one square.
[*] When mousing over a creature to attack it, if the creature has [b]Mirror Images[/b], the number of Mirror Images will be displayed in the tooltip.
[*] Fixed a bug with the reach of large creatures wielding a [b]Reach Weapon[/b]. Reach weapons were doubling the reach distance instead of just adding a single square.
[*] Fixed a bug with the reach of [b]very large creatures[/b] when their line-of-sight maximum distance wasn't enough to grant them the full extent of their reach in combat.
[*] Added some tooltip information when mousing over the small [b]Psionic Power Point expense buttons[/b], for people who may have difficulty reading the content of the tiny circles.
[*] Improved the information tooltip when mousing over a trader's [b]available items[/b]. It will display the [b]quantity available in store[/b], or the item's [b]number of charges[/b].
[*] Fixed display bugs in the [b]Local Map Screen[/b] when there are some text notes on the map. Some text notes could have a fractional position, reducing the quality of the text display.
[*] Fixed a damage-display problem when the [b]energy damage[/b] on a creature is reduced to [b]zero points[/b].
[*] Added some code to [b]accelerate gameplay in combat[/b].
[/list]
[b]Thank You For Your Awesome Support, Brave Heroes! Best Wishes ^_^[/b]

notes.title: Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.53
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you're well. Here's another [b]big update[/b] for [b]KotC 2[/b]! Yay! :-)

The main additions are the new [b]Combat Actions menu[/b] with icons, [b]custom hotkeys[/b] for spells and abilities in the Quickbar, the automatic [b]Flurry of Blows[/b] for Monks (so that you don't have to click as many times as before), and the new [b]Throw Creature[/b] combat action - use it to throw enemy creatures into pits and other environmental hazards, or you can throw them at other creatures. A creature that occupies 2x2 squares may be thrown at up to four creatures, potentially.

There is a new feat: [b]Improved Throw Creature[/b]. The feat [b]Greater Grapple[/b] was improved and some rules regarding grappling were improved. Holding a [b]shield[/b] now grants a bonus to Bull Rush, which increases when you have the feats [b]Shield Expertise[/b] or [b]Shield Mastery[/b]. Finally, the [b]AI[/b] was improved and various [b]bugs[/b] were fixed.

I'll post a new [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1848628223/knights-of-the-chalice-2-revolutionise-old-school-crpgs/posts]Kickstarter update[/url] soon.

If you find any bugs in [b]KotC 2[/b] version [b]1.53[/b], please drop me a line at [b]enquiries@heroicfantasygames.com[/b] so that I can fix the game quickly. A [b]saved game[/b] would be very useful, too. Thank you!!

If something doesn't work, remember that you can also revert to the [b]previous version[/b] of KotC 2 using the Steam/GOG interface.

My apologies for not replying on the forums these days. I'm having a nasty toothache and it's been ruining my productivity.

[b]List of changes in Knights of the Chalice 2 Version 1.53[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the [b]Iconised Combat Actions Menu[/b], and a new game option allowing you to switch it on and off. It is under 'Display', near the top, in third position. I prefer the new menu to the text-based one.
[*] Added to the Combat-Actions menu the actions [b]Breath Weapon[/b], [b]Gaze Attack[/b], [b]Turn Undead[/b], [b]Rage[/b], [b]Life Drain[/b], [b]Bard Songs[/b], and Cleric/Bishop [b]Domain Powers[/b]. Please note: the Rage and Bard Song combat actions will only be displayed when your character doesn't already have the associated Rage or Bard Song condition. That way, it will be much easier to know when is a good time to re-activate those abilities during a long battle.
[*] Added the new '[b]Auto Flurry[/b]' Combat Action for Monks. This new combat action lets the computer perform all of your Flurry attacks automatically on the target you specify.
[*] Added to the Spell Quickbar selection menu a list of choices allowing you to set a [b]Function key[/b] or a combination [b]Shift + Function key[/b] as the [b]hotkey for the selected spell[/b] or ability. Just scroll down the list after right clicking on a Spell Quickbar slot in order to display the keys from F2 to F12 and the combinations from Shift + F2 to Shift + F12. Pressing one of these hotkeys will then let you cast or activate the corresponding spell or ability. Added some text about this in the in-game help entry about shortcuts during combat. Also fixed some display issues when right clicking on a Spell Quickbar slot.
[*] Fixed a bug with Quickbar spells that have a [b]metamagic setting[/b], such as Empower.
[*] Added the brand new '[b]Throw Creature[/b]' Combat Action, available while grappling. Also added the new feat '[b]Improved Throw Creature[/b]'. Note: You can throw a creature at another creature (or at several creatures, if the thrown creature occupies more than one square). Simply select a square that contains a creature as your target position. The end position of the thrown creature will be a square adjacent to the recipient creature, but both will take damage, the thrown creature will be prone, and the recipient creature may also fall down.
[*] Given the feat [b]Improved Throw Creature[/b] to a number of creatures in both Augury of Chaos and the Tutorial Adventure. Also updated the creature AI settings for the AI to use the new Throw Creature action from time to time.
[*] The feat [b]Greater Grapple[/b] will now improve the grapple actions Break Free from Grapple or Pin, Pin, Swallow Whole and Throw Creature from Standard Action to Move Action. Note: To improve the 'Break Free from Grapple or Pin' action, there is also a feat called 'Improved Escape From Snares'. If you have both feats, you can now Break Free from a Grapple or Pin using a Free Action.
[*] A creature grappling a creature [b]three size categories smaller[/b] (or more) will no longer lose its Dexterity bonus to AC. For example, a Gargantuan creature grappling a Medium-size creature.
[*] When targeting a grappling opponent with a ranged attack, the [b]50%[/b] chance to hit the other grappling combatant will not apply if you are adjacent to the target or if the target is pinned. It also doesn't apply if you have the feat Improved Precise Shot. Also added a mention of this in the help entries.
[*] You will now receive a bonus of +2 on [b]Bull Rush checks[/b] when holding a [b]shield[/b]. This bonus increases to +3 with the feat Shield Expertise and +4 with the feat Shield Mastery. Updated the help entries for Bull Rush, Armour Types, Shield Expertise and Shield Mastery to reflect this.
[*] Fixed a bug with the [b]Character Creation interface[/b] not recording the selected animated sprite when you untick 'Auto-Create Character Sprite'.
[*] Added [b]shortcut keys[/b] for those combat actions that didn't have any: Pull (Shift+P), Slide (Q), Stand Up (U), Sunder (Shift+U), Trip (Shift+J), Disarm (Shift+G), Feint (Shift+N), Rearm (Shift+K), Throw Creature (Shift+O), Swallow Whole (Shift+W), Charge Attack (Shift+Z), Wake Someone Up (Shift+X). Also updated the in-game help entry about Keyboard Shortcuts During Combat with a mention of all the new shortcut keys.
[*] Tweaked the [b]melee attack AI[/b] when a target have been affected by a Feint combat manoeuvre. Also tweaked the AI for Feint attempts when the acting creature has the feat Greater Feint.
[*] When a [b]Feint[/b] attempt fails due to a Mirror Image, the game will indicate the number of mirror images remaining.
[*] Fixed some bugs due to confusion between the character conditions Feint and Improved Feint.
[*] The [b]Curing domain power[/b] used in conjonction with the Flux domain will no longer require a ranged touch attack.
[*] Fixed the [b]Difficulty Class[/b] of the Cleric/Bishop domain powers Life Drain, Weakness, Wilting, Confusion Touch, Paralysing Touch, Sickness Touch, Pandemonium, Blindness, Time, Fire, Storm, Sun. It was based on Charisma. Now it's based on Wisdom (as mentioned in the help).
[*] Pressing 'O' in the [b]Game Options[/b] screen will now close the screen.
[*] [b]Improved the AI[/b] so that it will avoid using spells or spell-like abilities like Life Drain on targets with extremely high Spell Resistance.
[*] The feat [b]Rapid Strike[/b] will no longer apply to the Monk's unarmed attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug that could occur when pushing a [b]number key[/b] to open the character sheet of a party member.
[*] Fixed a [b]source of crashes[/b] in combat when a creature has disarmed someone who has an ongoing condition such as Bleeding. Upon applying the effect of bleeding to the character, there could be a crash because of the Disarmed condition giving one more condition to the character (the condition No Shield Bonus to AC), thereby invalidating the pointer to the data of the Bleeding effect. It's a memory-related bug so it would not happen every time. The bug could also happen when a Death Knight moves close to another creature, applying the effect of the Death Knight's aura.
[*] Fixed a number of bugs and issues concerning the [b]Bleeding[/b] condition, in particular when several characters have the Bleeding condition, and when monsters have natural attacks that cause bleeding. Also improved the Combat-Log reporting for Bleeding and Bleeding increases. Also improved the help entries for the Monster Ability Bleeding, the Death Knight feat Vicious Strike, and the weapon enchantment Vicious.
[*] Fixed a bug with [b]summon spells[/b] that could be targeted very far from the caster.
[*] The game will play a sound effect when [b]Pin attempts[/b] are unsuccessful.
[*] Fixed a bunch of [b]Combat-Log errors[/b] when the player uses a potion, scroll, wand or other item.
[*] You'll be able to [b]Counterspell[/b] a spell cast from a scroll or wand.
[*] Corrected the item descriptions of all the [b]magic acorns[/b] and the Lesser Fireball Necklace to specify that their activation is a supernatural ability (not a spell-like ability).
[*] Fixed a bug in the [b]module editor[/b] that could cause crashes.
[*] Fixed position problems with the [b]Prone sprites[/b] of various Trolls.
[*] When targeting a spell with a [b]metamagic effect[/b], the game will display it at the top, e.g. Empowered Fireball.
[*] Fixed issues with the [b]Formation Screen[/b] when setting as leader (or removing as leader) a creature that occupies more than one square.
[*] Fixed issues in the [b]Token / Sprite selection screen[/b] when the character occupies more than one square.
[*] Improved the help entry about [b]Attacks of Opportunity[/b] with links to the Combat Actions entry and the entries for feats that remove AOOs.
[*] Added some text and links in the help entries for [b]Improved Grapple[/b], [b]Greater Grapple[/b], and [b]Break Free[/b].
[*] Fixed an error in the help entry for [b]Grapple[/b] (there is no penalty for Grapple Attacks even if you don't have the feat Improved Grapple).
[*] [b]Improved the combat interface[/b] so that all of the shortcut keys are displayed when mousing over an option. Also fixed some Combat Action display issues during combat, and a display issue in the Party Creation screen.
[*] Fixed some issues with the [b]menus[/b] when you want to use the keyboard to select an option rather than the mouse.
[*] Fixed a broken link at the bottom of the help entry for [b]Critical Hits[/b]. Also fixed the help link when right clicking on the Combat Actions [b]Rearm[/b] and [b]Activate Special[/b].
[*] In the Creature Editor, normally, when you change the [b]unique name[/b] of a creature, the game will update the name of the creature in all of the scripts of the module. This will no longer happen if you have loaded a creature file (such as the creature file from a saved game) since the loaded file is not the module's creature file. Also fixed some interface issues in the Creature Editor in the Feats and Abilities screen.
[*] Added some code to [b]accelerate gameplay in combat[/b].
[/list]
[b]Happy Christmas time everyone!! Enjoy, dear Knights of the Realm! ^_^[/b]
